english.title: Cause provision of false defence exemption certificate / copy
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who was, in accordance with paragraph 6 of Schedule 4 to the REACH Enforcement Regulations 2008, required to produce a

(A)_[Defence Exemption Certificate,]_
(B)_[a copy of a Defence Exemption Certificate made by the Secretary of State,]_
(C)_[a copy made by the Secretary of State of a relevant extract of a Defence Exemption Certificate,]_

caused a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to provide a false

(D)_[certificate]_
(E)_[copy]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(3)(a) and 12 of the REACH Enforcement Regulations 2008.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
